Focal announcement: Meet four emerging filmmakers redefining the art form with MAMI Select: Filmed on iPhone.

Decision cutoff: 2026-05-07T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Meet four emerging filmmakers redefining the art form with MAMI Select: Filmed on iPhone. Published date: 2026-05-07. URL: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/05/how-filmmakers-are-redefining-the-art-form-with-mami-select-filmed-on-iphone.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: In telling the stories of a clandestine affair on the streets of Mumbai, divinity and humanity in Kerala, a young misfit navigating Goa’s vibrant beaches, and a Bengali woman terrified of losing her voice, the emerging auteurs included in this year’s MAMI Select: Filmed on iPhone program from the Mumbai Academy of Moving Image (MAMI) harnessed iPhone 17 Pro Max to construct short films with distinct cinematic languages. “The possibilities iPhone opens up — in terms of choreography, movement, and ease of access — are redefining the art form,” says Tamhane, whose features Court (2014) and The Disciple (2020) earned recognition at the Venice Film Festival. “We tested iPhone 17 Pro Max in a very unique way,” says Agarwal. His MAMI Select: Filmed on iPhone entry, She Sells Seashells , follows Maruti, a 17-year-old Rajasthani migrant who sells trinkets on the beach, and her dream of stepping inside an upmarket seaside restaurant in Goa — a seemingly trivial act that becomes a study in dignity in the director’s capable hands. Shot on iPhone 7 during the height of the COVID pandemic, her first short film, Chhaddonam ( Pen Name ), went on to be acquired by MUBI.
